title: Super Real Mahjong P7
overview:
The latest in the Real Mahjong series is finally here!

Packed with original content, including special animation only in the Sega Saturn version.

Super Real Mahjong P7 is a one-player mahjong game for adults, adapted from the arcade original. Spend a summer at a holiday villa and take on the family staying there and their tutor in one-on-one mahjong, winning animated scenes as you go. The Saturn version also adds a quiz mode and a collection of the game's design materials. This is the limited edition release.

- Memory backup save
- Supports the Extended RAM Cartridge (1MB and 4MB) for shorter loading

リアル麻雀シリーズ最新作、ついに登場！

セガサターン版だけのスペシャルアニメーションなど、オリジナル要素満載。
